why_human: Determines which identity source can issue immutable tenant/project/service IDs and revoke them.
required_artifact: Authority policy, issuer trust roots, identifier lifecycle, audit ownership.
default_safety_posture: No cache-key issuance without authoritative immutable IDs.

why_human: Defines whether content equality may be shared within a project, tenant, explicit group, or public/system namespace.
required_artifact: Approved sharing classes and promotion workflow.
default_safety_posture: Private tenant/project scope; no cross-tenant dedup.

why_human: Defines who can create, unwrap, escrow, rotate, revoke, and destroy roots and backups.
required_artifact: RACI/quorum, KMS policy, escrow and legal-hold rules.

why_human: A regenerable cache may not merit backup; retaining it expands key copies and deletion obligations.
required_artifact: Data classification, RPO/RTO, retention and legal-hold policy.

why_human: Some caches tolerate stale valid data; others need a monotonic source generation.
required_artifact: Maximum tolerated staleness and trusted state design.
default_safety_posture: Reject epochs/generations below current trusted floor.

why_human: Depends on media, provider capability, reuse/disposition, regulatory policy, and evidence threshold.
required_artifact: Media-specific procedure, verification/validation criteria, disposition record.
default_safety_posture: Do not assert sanitization without procedure evidence.
